ProgramUnit.Name: DUPLI_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dupli_check IS
 temp_v_don_type varchar2(50);
 temp_v_proc_code varchar2(10);
 temp_v_attrib_group varchar2(50);
 temp_v_attrib_code varchar2(50);
 temp_v_item_name varchar2(50);
 temp_c_rec_no VARCHAR2(2);
BEGIN
 temp_v_don_type := :donation_type;
 temp_v_proc_code := :procedure_code;
 temp_v_attrib_group := :attrib_group;
 temp_v_attrib_code := :attrib_code;
 temp_v_item_name := :system.cursor_item;
 temp_c_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 go_record('1');
 LOOP
 IF :donation_type = temp_v_don_type AND
 :system.trigger_record != temp_c_rec_no AND
 :attrib_group = temp_v_attrib_group AND
 :attrib_code = temp_v_attrib_code 
 THEN
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 IF :procedure_code = temp_v_proc_code AND
 :system.trigger_record != temp_c_rec_no AND
 :attrib_group = temp_v_attrib_group AND
 :attrib_code = temp_v_attrib_code 
 THEN
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 IF :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 THEN
 exit;
 ELSE
 down;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DONATION_TYPE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_donation_type IS
 temp_v_don_type varchar2(50);
 temp_v_item_name varchar2(50);
 temp_c_rec_no VARCHAR2(2);
BEGIN
 temp_v_don_type := :donation_type;
 temp_v_item_name := :system.cursor_item;
 temp_c_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 go_record('1');
 LOOP
 IF :donation_type = temp_v_don_type AND
 :system.trigger_record != temp_c_rec_no 
 THEN
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 show_error('0036');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 IF :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 THEN
 exit;
 ELSE
 down;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ATTRIB_GROUP_LOV5
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code, code_desc from master_codes where code_type = 'ATTR' and length(code) > 1 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) order by code

RecordGroup.Name: RG_PROCEDURE_CODE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select procedure_code, description from valid_proc_codes where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DONATION_TYPE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select donation_type code, description code_desc from valid_donation_types where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ATTRIB_CODE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct attrib_code , substr(attrib_desc,1,31),' ', decode(valid_attributes.inter_code,'','OK',''),' ', decode(inter_type,'N','NFT', 'H','Hold', 'B','BIO', 'I','Initial', '') from valid_attributes, valid_interdictions_lab where attrib_group = :attrib_group and sysdate between valid_attributes.eff_date and nvl(valid_attributes.term_date,sysdate+365) and status_flag != 'A' and valid_attributes.inter_code = valid_interdictions_lab.inter_code(+) order by attrib_code
